meta.name: story-import
meta.description: 逆向导入已有小说。将已写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析为标准项目目录结构，兼容 story-long-write / story-short-write 后续写作流程；内部复用 story-long-analyze / story-short-analyze 的拆解管道，按篇幅自动分流。触发方式：/story-import、「导入小说」「反向解析」「导入」「把我的书导进来」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把已有小说导入标准写作流程，自动拆解续写
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你写了半成品或完本小说，想用写作工具继续加工
copy.tagline_en: Import your existing novel into a standard writing workflow for easier continuation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a half-finished or complete novel and want to continue it with writing tools

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能接收你已写好的小说全文或文件，先按长/短篇拆解分析，再整理成设定、大纲、正文、追踪齐全的项目结构，让你能直接接着写下去。
howto.when: 当你说出“导入小说”“反向解析”等词，或要求把已有小说导入工程并提供原文/文件路径时触发；也用于回答导入续写流程的问题。

say.text: 导入小说，文件在电脑上：/books/我的书.md
say.note: Claude 会询问书名、篇幅等并开始拆解。

say.text: 把我的这本完本小说反向解析，做成可续写项目。
say.note: 会先做全书拆解，再迁移成项目结构。

say.text: 这篇写到一半，我想导入后接着往下写。
say.note: 导入完成后即可续写第N章。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can accept your existing novel (full text or file), auto-route by length, deeply analyze it, and rebuild a writable project (setting/outline/chapters/tracking) so you can continue writing directly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say things like 'import novel'/'reverse-parse', or ask to import an existing novel by providing text/path. It also fires when you ask about the import-and-continue workflow.

say_en.text: Import a novel; file is on my PC: /books/mybook.md.
say_en.note: Claude asks for details, then starts parsing.

say_en.text: Reverse-parse this completed novel into a writable project.
say_en.note: It will fully analyze then migrate.

say_en.text: This story is half-written; import it so I can continue later.
say_en.note: Import finishes before you can continue.
